description: Every required skill met, no preferred skill at all.

expectations.rationale: A frontend CV meets 2 of 11 required full-stack skills. The original 40% minimum assumed 4, which is not what this resume has. The calibration point is unchanged and is the preferred dimension: with zero of eight preferred skills present the preferred score must be near zero, and the overall must not be rescued by the required partial match. Corrected in CALIBRATION.md.
